text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, well, I'm in high spirits!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
While it may not all have shown up in the final results,
this can certainly be called a great leap forward!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"I must offer you some words of appreciation as well,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Allow me to offer my heartfelt thanks to you, who works so hard every day as my test subject!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well now, you should just accept their gratitude graciously.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow begins another daily routine of experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let us devote ourselves diligently, so that our hard work may bear fruit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Our research has only just begun, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We can't afford to let our guard down.
It seems you understand that as well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us keep broadening our possibilities like this,
and reach beyond the limits of Umamusume!
